author: kesudh
method: Independent cold construction from benchmark pins; versioned driver-rooted SPT routing, negotiated vertex congestion, exact per-net descent, fixed-work group LNS and displacement-chain refinement of the same invocation own cold output. Exact method, seed and work counts are recorded per producing source version and case.
hardware: Intel Core i7-13700HX (16C/24T), 31.7 GiB RAM, Windows 11
route_inputs: Benchmark instance JSON only. All intermediate geometry is constructed in this invocation; no published routes, reference solutions, prior-entry routes or trained geometry artifacts.
runtime_scope: One complete solver process per case, including input parsing, cold construction, every internal refinement/portfolio phase, output serialization and process exit. Excludes compilation, pre-run instance copying and post-run official checking. Actual producing runs and times are retained when experiments do not improve them.
source: reproducers/<runs.json source_version>/router/src/main.rs under the shared intro entry
algorithm_credit: Search code adapted from kesudh earlier Rust engine; no geometry reused. Standard SPT, PathFinder-style negotiation, LNS and displacement-chain techniques; conflict splitting adapted from Sharon et al.
configuration_policy: Each case runs.json solver_args and immutable source_version determine its exact producing configuration; CLI defaults do not replace those records.
